name: Line Grid
description: Faithful Line Grid for Komari RPC2 with upstream-style detailed globe coastlines, reliable traffic-cycle persistence, saved-value feedback, balanced labels, responsive layouts, privacy-aware finance and admin persistence.
author: line-grid theme contributors / DeterminantMatrix

help.en: First, Keep, or Last. Within each group nodes follow Komari weight order.
help.zh-CN: First / Keep / Last；组内严格按 Komari weight 顺序。

help.en: Used by nodes without a per-node override. Range: 1-31.
help.zh-CN: 未单独填写的 VPS 使用这里的日期；范围 1～31。

help.en: One node per line: VPS name = day. UUID = day is also accepted. Example: My HK VPS = 15. Range: 1-31. Empty nodes use the default above.
help.zh-CN: 一行一台：VPS名称 = 日期；也支持 UUID = 日期。例：华纳云HK = 15。日期范围 1～31；未填写的节点使用上方默认值。适合大量 VPS 批量维护。

name.zh-CN: 启用 GeoIP / ASN 识别

help.en: Opt-in. Full node IPs visible to your current account are sent to public GeoIP providers. Results are cached without storing the IP in the cache key.
help.zh-CN: 隐私敏感，默认关闭。开启后会将当前账号可见的完整节点 IP 发送给公共 GeoIP 服务；缓存键不保存明文 IP。
